message:
Explore Bali is a travel and tour booking platform built in 2026 using pure PHP and MySQL — no framework at all. It showcases Bali destinations with detail galleries, offers flight, hotel, bus, and car search flows, and includes tiket.com booking deep-links plus visa information.

Some highlights: it spans 16+ pages deployable on shared hosting, features 6 destinations with detail galleries backed by a 14-table MySQL schema, and integrates real booking deep-links for airlines like Lion Air and Garuda Indonesia.

The stack includes PHP Native, MySQL/MariaDB, mysqli, HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, and Apache. You can view the source code at github.com/qoidrifat/explore-bali.
